# Mark review

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md). Read the current canonical draft, requested scope and relevant private style/examples if accessible. Review specificity, voice fidelity and consistency, not compliance with an invented house persona.

Record findings in mark.state.md using [the review template](../../../templates/review.state.md): canonical_draft, reviewed_revision, scope, outcome, passages, proposed moves and author disposition. Do not edit the draft or insert hidden comments during review.

The author, not Mark, chooses editorial wording and acceptable style. Separate factual/evidence problems from taste. Use ready/revise/blocked/not-needed with the v1 meanings; old CLEAR/POLISH labels do not establish current clearance.
